tool_definitions.name: bash
tool_definitions.description: Run a shell command on the Linux workstation.

tool_definitions.name: read_document
tool_definitions.description: Download a business document by name.

tool_definitions.name: request_document
tool_definitions.description: Open a project request for a missing business document.

tool_definitions.name: list_document_requests
tool_definitions.description: List one page of project document requests.

tool_definitions.name: attach_requested_document
tool_definitions.description: Attach a document available in this workstation to an open project request.

tool_definitions.name: read_requested_document
tool_definitions.description: Read the document attached to a fulfilled project request.

tool_definitions.name: create_order
tool_definitions.description: Create a draft supplier order using its supplier quote reference.

tool_definitions.name: approve_order
tool_definitions.description: Approve a draft supplier order against the cost-centre budget.

tool_definitions.name: issue_order
tool_definitions.description: Issue an approved supplier order and record its financial commitment.

tool_definitions.name: cancel_order
tool_definitions.description: Cancel a draft or approved supplier order.

tool_definitions.name: order_status
tool_definitions.description: Read current supplier orders and recorded commitments.

tool_definitions.name: record_reconciliation
tool_definitions.description: Record issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation in the project register.

steps.message: Order the items in RECOVERY-000003-requisition.json for Recovery Site 000003. Supplier quotes and the cost-centre budget are in the document service. Record the issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation in the project register, and return them.
